The module is a non-visual singleton SSE connection manager: one shared browser EventSource('/api/v1/events'), a named-event fan-out, and two live-pipe metadata trackers (lastMessageAt, hasEverConnected). No JSX, no Recharts/Leaflet, no web UI components — the only browser-coupled surfaces are the EventSource constructor, the same-origin relative URL, and window.setTimeout, each ported behind the established native-parity globalThis-probe / shared-helper precedent (notificationSound / safeUUID / recentPages / useKeyboardShortcuts).

Added native-only artifacts with no web equivalent: the `SSEMessageEventLike { data: string }` and `EventSourceLike` structural interfaces and the `EventSourceCtor` type (describing exactly the EventSource surface used, since the DOM lib is excluded), `getEventSourceCtor()` (the globalThis.EventSource probe, returning the ctor only when typeof === 'function'), and the exported `isSseStreamingAvailable()` predicate that surfaces the explicit native-unavailable state. The single import `apiUrl` from ../api/client replaces the web same-origin relative URL. None of these alter behaviour on a runtime that has EventSource (react-native-web or a registered polyfill).
